description: This Java interface defines configuration settings for a MongoDB connection within a specific service, including details for connection pooling, circuit breakers, monitoring, and option preferences.

classes.name: MongoDbConfig
classes.description: Main interface providing access to various MongoDB configuration settings, including query time, URI, options, connection pool, circuit breaker, and monitoring configurations.

classes.name: MongoDbConfig.MongoDbConfigValue
classes.description: Enumeration of known configuration values with default settings for the main MongoDbConfig.

classes.name: OptionsConfig
classes.description: Nested interface defining configuration options related to MongoDB options such as SSL and read preferences.

classes.name: OptionsConfig.OptionsConfigValue
classes.description: Enumeration of known configuration paths and default values for OptionsConfig.

classes.name: ConnectionPoolConfig
classes.description: Nested interface detailing configuration options for the MongoDB connection pool, including size, wait queue, and JMX listener.

classes.name: ConnectionPoolConfig.ConnectionPoolConfigValue
classes.description: Enumeration of default values and config paths for connection pool settings.

classes.name: CircuitBreakerConfig
classes.description: Nested interface encapsulating settings for the circuit breaker, including failure thresholds and timeout configurations.

classes.name: CircuitBreakerConfig.CircuitBreakerConfigValue
classes.description: Enumeration of config paths and default maximum failures for the circuit breaker.

classes.name: TimeoutConfig
classes.description: Nested interface within CircuitBreakerConfig providing timeout durations for circuit breaker operation.

classes.name: TimeoutConfig.TimeoutConfigValue
classes.description: Enumeration for default call and reset durations for the circuit breaker.

classes.name: MonitoringConfig
classes.description: Nested interface providing settings for monitoring MongoDB commands and connection pool statistics.

classes.name: MonitoringConfig.MonitoringConfigValue
classes.description: Enumeration of default boolean flags for monitoring configurations.

methods.name: getMaxQueryTime
methods.description: Returns the maximum duration allowed for a query.

methods.name: getMongoDbUri
methods.description: Provides the MongoDB URI derived from source URI and settings.

methods.name: getOptionsConfig
methods.description: Returns the options configuration for MongoDB connection.

methods.name: getConnectionPoolConfig
methods.description: Provides configuration for the MongoDB connection pool.

methods.name: getCircuitBreakerConfig
methods.description: Returns the circuit breaker configuration settings.
